```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
# Labels are the shared position-group names; the codes group the roster
# positions (defensive ends and tackles form one defensive line).
pos_label <- setNames(
  position_group(c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "OL", "DL", "LB", "DB", "PK")),
  c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "OL", "DL", "LB", "DB", "ST")
)
# The positions whose redshirt flag the box score can read.
usable <- c("QB", "RB", "WR", "LB", "ST")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Every regular-season stat line, by player-season, against the team's covered
# games. Seasons still being played are left out of the rates.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
gp_all <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(seasonType == "regular") |>
  select(playerId, season, team, gameId, category, statType, stat) |>
  collect()
pos_of <- tbl(con, "roster") |>
  select(playerId, season, team, position) |>
  distinct() |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    pos = case_when(
      position == "QB" ~ "QB",
      position %in% c("RB", "FB") ~ "RB",
      position == "WR" ~ "WR",
      position == "TE" ~ "TE",
      position %in% c("OL", "G", "OT", "C") ~ "OL",
      position %in% c("DL", "DT", "NT", "DE", "EDGE") ~ "DL",
      position %in% c("LB", "OLB", "ILB") ~ "LB",
      position %in% c("DB", "S", "CB") ~ "DB",
      position %in% c("PK", "P", "LS") ~ "ST"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(pos), !position %in% c("?", "ATH", "PR", "KR")) |>
  group_by(playerId, season) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
covered <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(season, team, gameId) |>
  count(season, team, name = "games_covered") |>
  collect()

# Season volume: attempts, carries, receptions, tackles or kicks, summed over
# the season; the full-time seasons are the top quarter of each position.
core_all <- gp_all |>
  inner_join(pos_of |> select(-team), by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  filter(
    (pos == "QB" & category == "passing" & statType == "C/ATT") |
      (pos %in%
        c("RB", "WR", "TE") &
        category %in% c("rushing", "receiving") &
        statType %in% c("CAR", "REC")) |
      (pos %in%
        c("DL", "LB", "DB") &
        category == "defensive" &
        statType == "TOT") |
      (pos == "ST" &
        category %in% c("kicking", "punting") &
        statType %in% c("XP", "FG", "NO"))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    v = if_else(pos == "QB", as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", stat)), as.numeric(stat))
  )
season_volume <- core_all |>
  group_by(playerId, season, pos) |>
  summarize(volume = sum(v, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
stat_rate <- gp_all |>
  distinct(playerId, season, team, gameId) |>
  count(playerId, season, team, name = "games_with_stat") |>
  inner_join(pos_of |> select(-team), by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  left_join(season_volume, by = c("playerId", "season", "pos")) |>
  left_join(covered, by = c("season", "team")) |>
  filter(!is.na(games_covered), games_covered >= 5, season <= complete_through) |>
  mutate(rate = games_with_stat / games_covered)

obs <- observability_by_position(
  filter(stat_rate, !is.na(volume)),
  complete_through
) |>
  filter(full_time) |>
  mutate(
    Position = reorder(unname(pos_label[pos]), rate),
    is_usable = pos %in% usable,
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: a statistic in %s of covered games in a full-time season (%s seasons)",
      Position,
      scales::percent(rate, accuracy = 1),
      fmt(n)
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(obs, aes(rate, Position, fill = is_usable)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = pos), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#9CA3AF"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Does a full-time player show up in nearly every covered game?",
    subtitle = "Median share of covered games with a recorded statistic, full-time seasons; dark grey marks positions the redshirt flag can be read for",
    x = "Covered games with a statistic",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "covered-game-observability", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: distribution-figure
# How many covered games each player-season shows a statistic in, for the
# positions the redshirt flag applies to.
obs_hist <- stat_rate |>
  filter(pos %in% usable, games_with_stat <= 15) |>
  count(pos, games_with_stat, name = "n") |>
  mutate(
    Position = unname(pos_label[pos]),
    flagged = games_with_stat <= 1
  )
p_hist <- ggplot(obs_hist, aes(games_with_stat, n)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = flagged,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s player-seasons with a statistic in %d games",
        Position,
        fmt(n),
        games_with_stat
      ),
      data_id = paste(pos, games_with_stat)
    ),
    width = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Position, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#9CA3AF"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "One game or none", `FALSE` = "Two or more games"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Is there a spike at zero or one game, then real backup seasons?",
    subtitle = "Player-seasons by covered games with a statistic, positions the redshirt flag applies to",
    x = "Covered games with a recorded statistic",
    y = "Player-seasons",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_hist)
```
